headline: Authentic Brands Group Acquires O'Neill
summary: Authentic Brands Group has acquired the lifestyle and outdoor brand O'Neill. The deal aims to expand Authentic's global portfolio across content, experiences, and commerce.
why: Authentic Brands Group is a major player in the retail and brand management space, frequently acquiring distressed or legacy brands to leverage its global licensing platform.

impacts.name: Authentic Brands Group
impacts.why: Acquisitions are intended to drive long-term growth but involve integration risks.
